text.en:
All barangays and sitios in the island of Limasawa in the Municipality of Padre Burgos,
Province of Southern Leyte, are hereby detached and separated therefrom to form and constitute a distinct and
independent municipality to be known as the Municipality of Limasawa the seat of government of which shall
be in Barangay Triana: Provided, That this Decree shall not affect the legal existence of the Municipality of
Padre Burgos as such.

The present elective municipal officials of the Municipality of Padre Burgos shall continue to
perform their duties as such officials in the new Municipality of Limasawa until the officials of the latter
municipality shall have been appointed by the President of the Philippines and shall have qualified: Provided,
That the officials so appointed shall hold office until their successors shall have been elected in a regular
election and duly qualified, unless sooner removed by the President of the Philippines.

Such appointive officers and employees as may be necessary to organize and complete the
government of the Municipality of Limasawa shall be appointed as provided for under existing laws.

Upon the effectivity of this Decree the proportionate share of the Municipality of Limasawa in
the obligations, funds, assets and other property of the Municipality of Padre Burgos duly appertaining to the
former shall be transferred to and be borne by the Municipality of Limasawa, as determined by the
Commission on Audit and approve by the President of the Philippines.

All laws, decrees, orders, rules and regulations inconsistent with this Decree are hereby repealed,
modified or amended accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
